title: Spike dock stays clear of form fields
summary: Spike’s floating tip starts as a small avatar and keeps main content clear of the dock so Priority, Health, and similar form controls stay usable.
changes: Collapse the Spike tip dock to an avatar-only control by default; expand the tip on demand.
Add bottom clearance on main content when the dock is present so lower form fields can scroll clear of the avatar.
version_rationale: Patch release: keeps Spike available while fixing form-field overlap without changing tip content or dismiss behaviour.
validation: PHPUnit MascotHelperTest covers collapsed dock markup, clearance class, ticket and pet create pages, and change-log dock hiding.
Local preview on CIC tickets and Shelter pets confirmed Priority and Health remain usable with the dock present.
composer pre-pr-verify run on the PR branch before merge.
known_limitations: UK date formatting (#132) and later Public UX items remain separate follow-ups.
rollback: Redeploy the previous application version to restore the always-expanded Spike tip dock without the new main-content clearance.
provenance: Spike dock field overlap fix for issue #131, pull request #195.
